milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Target is the middle of the brown concrete path. Reduced max_distance to 8 to require some intentional movement from spawn.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because yellow stained glass drops nothing without Silk Touch, so inventory_has cannot be used. Checks that at most 8 of the original 9 glass blocks remain, meaning at least 1 was mined.

Uses position_inside_box instead of position_near_with_facing because the structure is too small — proximity checks can be satisfied from outside the walls. The box [9,0,7] to [11,1,11] matches the structure interior, ensuring the player must physically enter through the mined glass opening.
